author: Debbie
content: I had this game on my old cell phone (Nokia 3315) under the name of Bantumi. It's so much cooler than Snake, although once you've figured out a way to win the phone never changes it's moves so the game gets a bit repetitive. On another note, I used to have an Atari 800XL with a collection of about 12 games on tape. You are the only other person I know to have played tape computer games :)
